relevant_laws.quote: Any pedestrian crossing a roadway at a point where a pedestrian tunnel or overhead pedestrian crossing has been provided shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway. The foregoing rules in this Section shall have no application under the conditions stated in Section 11.30.070 when pedestrians are prohibited from crossing at certain designated places.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: roadway crossing at a provided overhead crossing
relevant_laws.notes: Authored deck is a candidate; original provision/access and designation need separate review.
